overviewCleanNote: Cleaning moves pages to the standby list, so apps may open a little slower, but memory becomes available for new tasks.
autoLastNone: The app has not cleaned memory yet.
historyEmpty: Results will appear here after the first cleanup.
autoDescription: Interval and threshold work together, and the cooldown keeps the app from stepping in too often.
autoNote: The threshold is checked every two seconds and fires only above the value and when there is cached memory to free. The interval counts from the last cleanup, including a manual one.
areaWorkingSetsDesc: Trims working sets of apps that have not been active for a while.
areaStandbyDesc: Releases the file cache Windows keeps around just in case.
areaModifiedDesc: Flushes pending writes to disk, the only area that loads the drive.
areaFileCacheDesc: Frees the system file cache that is rarely reused.
areasNote: The standby list and the file cache speed up reopening apps, so after cleaning some data is read from disk again.
exceptionsDesc: Processes in the list are skipped when working sets are trimmed, the other areas still apply to the whole system.
exceptionsHint: Process names separated by commas, for example steam.exe, Docker Desktop. Case and extension are optional.
startupDesc: A scheduled task starts with the needed rights and hides into the tray, so no window appears.
trayDesc: The close button hides the window while the app keeps watching memory.
notificationsDesc: A short message appears after an automatic cleanup.
hotkeyDesc: The shortcut works from any app unless another program took it and does not clash with AltGr layouts.
languageDesc: The Windows interface language is used by default, Russian for Russian-speaking regions and English everywhere else.
autoSaveHint: Changes are saved automatically to your local profile folder, no separate button is needed.
validationAreas: Choose at least one area, otherwise there is nothing to clean.
validationTriggers: Enable the interval or the threshold, otherwise automatic cleanup will not run.
hotkeyTaken: Windows did not give Ctrl+Shift+M, another program probably owns it. You can disable the shortcut or free the combination.
autostartDeleteFailed: Could not disable autostart, please try again.
autostartNoPath: Could not determine the application path.
autostartRejected: Autostart is allowed only for a copy installed in Program Files.
autostartCreateFailed: Windows did not allow creating the autostart task.
autostartPrepareFailed: Could not prepare the autostart task.
resultCleaning: Cleaning memory, it takes a couple of seconds.
resultNothing: There was enough free memory already, so there was almost nothing to release.
resultPartial: Freed {0}, but not everything went smoothly.
errorDebugPrivilege: the system did not grant access to other processes
errorFileCache: the system did not allow resetting the file cache
adminRequired: memcleaner frees memory at system level, so it needs administrator rights.
autostartTaskDescription: memcleaner starts with Windows and watches memory in the background
unexpectedError: memcleaner ran into an unexpected error. The details are in the application log, the app keeps running.
